The Trail Blazer is here – the ultimate trail and hiking shoe designed for those who crave both performance and comfort on rugged terrain. products.title: Altra Running Men's Lone Peak 9 Trail Shoes

description.plain:
Harness the freedom and confidence to go after legendary adventures on the trail in a shoe that's been doing it for years. Make memories for miles. The Lone Peak 9 is Altra's iconic all-around trail runner — built for trail running, hiking, and thru hiking with a max-cushion stack, StoneGuard™ rock plate, and grippy MaxTrac™ outsole. The original FootShape™ fit gives you the roomiest toe box for natural movement and stability on technical terrain, while Altra EGO™ midsole foam delivers a responsive, connected feel underfoot. GaiterTrap™ lets you strap on a Trail Gaiter in seconds for debris-free miles on dusty or muddy trails. Available in Regular and Wide widths.

Original FootShape™ Fit
With Altra's signature FootShape™ fit, you get our roomiest toe box with plenty of room to help your toes move freely, and space through the midfoot for natural movement on technical terrain.
Available in Wide Width
The Lone Peak 9 is offered in both Regular and Wide widths so you can find the perfect fit for broader feet — extra room through the forefoot and toe box for natural spread.
MaxTrac™ Trail Grip
Our grippy MaxTrac™ outsole provides the perfect combination of grip, traction, and durability on all types of terrain — from smooth dirt to rocky scrambles.
Altra EGO™ Midsole
Connect with the ground and stay comfortable with unique Altra EGO™ midsole foam — responsive cushioning for the long haul.
StoneGuard™ Rock Protection
A StoneGuard™ provides underfoot protection on the trail, over rocks, debris, and tough terrain with a flexible yet firm and stable feel.
GaiterTrap™ Trail Gaiter Tab
GaiterTrap™, our unique hook-and-loop tab, allows for easy strapless gaiter attachment without fasteners, bungees, or bindings. Trail debris in your shoes? No thanks.
APMA Seal of Acceptance
This product received the American Podiatric Medical Association (APMA) Seal of Acceptance, awarded to products found to promote good foot health.

description.plain:
Built for speed, agility, and raw trail feedback, the Strappers are the ultimate barefoot trail running shoes for off-road runners. Featuring an integrated, secure strap system, these shoes lock your midfoot down over a thin, highly flexible sole, preventing internal slipping during steep descents and sharp turns.

Designed for pure barefoot running, the Strappers remove thick midsoles to let your feet react instantly to rocks, roots, and changes in the dirt. The flat, zero drop design encourages a midfoot strike, reducing joint impact and strengthening your lower legs naturally.

The wide toe box provides the necessary room for your forefoot to splay and stabilize your landing. A puncture-resistant, high-grip rubber outsole keeps you grounded on loose dirt, wet grass, and rugged terrain without adding weight. The breathable, debris-defying mesh upper keeps your feet clean and cool. Lace up the Strappers and discover a fast, natural, and completely connected trail running experience.

The breathable, foot-hugging upper supports every stride over varied terrain. Abrasion-resistant overlays add trail-proven durability, and the gusseted tongue seals out debris. Lightstrike Pro cushioning maintains a light feel, and the rocker shape promotes a smooth roll-off for a quick pace. The Continental Rubber outsole and lugged tread maintain secure footing across roots and rocks, wet or dry.
